description: This Go source file defines functions for merging OpenAPI specifications (both Swagger and OpenAPI v3) used in Kubernetes API extensions. It includes functions to merge multiple specs, handle conflicts, and preserve certain group version schemas.

methods.name: MergeSpecs
methods.description: Aggregates multiple Swagger specs, prioritizing the static spec and merging in CRD specs while avoiding conflicts.

methods.name: mergeSpec
methods.description: Copies definitions, parameters, and paths from source Swagger spec to destination, mutating the destination.

methods.name: MergeSpecsV3
methods.description: Merges multiple OpenAPI v3 specs, handling conflicts for specific group versions.

methods.name: mergeSpecV3
methods.description: Copies schemas and paths from source to destination OpenAPI v3 spec, skipping conflicts for certain group versions.
